inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Infant Not in Crib with Drop Gate Down: An infant was observed inside cribs with the drop gate open. This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Infant Not in Crib with Drop Gate Down (26 TAC §746.2409(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: The documentation provided indicates that the center has not been completing its weekly and monthly maintenance outdoor checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infant feeding insturction reviewed had not been updated withing the required 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent licensing inspection report was not posted in a visible area. This was corrected during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - License: The center License permit was not posted in a visible area. This was corrected during inspection and was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - License (26 TAC §746.401(1))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the inspection, several trash cans without lids were observed, making the trash visible and accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection, it was noted that the diaper changing mat had several visible rips and tears. These damages exposed the underlying material.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: During the inspection, it was observed that the large playground gate is damaged and fails to latch securely. Additionally, several outdoor toys were found to be broken, and there was hazardous trash present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe: During the inspection, the "Keeping Children Safe" notice was not posted in a prominent area. This  was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Notice-Keeping Children Safe (26 TAC §746.401(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: During the inspection, staff was unable to provide me with the ages of the children she was caring for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: During the inspection, it was observed that the playground's loose fill surfacing did not meet the required minimum depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Staff files were not available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Staff files were not available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Two child's file did not have the required documentation for the health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Two cups in the infant room were not labeld as required. This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The center did not notify CCR within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff member was observed with director access to children in care without have a completed background check. This was corrected during the inspection the staff member left.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Walls and flooring in the building are in need of repair. The repairs were needed with the last inspection and the department was told it would be done, however, as of today the same repairs have not been made.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: 6 employee files were reviewed and all 6 were missing their notarized Affidavits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: 6 employee files were reviewed and 5 were missing a copy of their ID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: 5 of the 8 staff files reviewed did not have documented proof of having completed orientation.    Proof of orientation was received for new staff and is now in compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Only 1 of the 8 staff files evaluated had current first aid training as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Only 1 of the 8 files evaluated had current  Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing as required
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: No monthly fire extinguisher inspection was available to review for compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: The emergency diagram was missing from 3 of the classrooms as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: 1 infant crib that was currently being used for an infant in care was observed to have loose sheets that were not tight/snug fitting as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: When reviewing the directors file, only 21 of the 30 required annual training hours were available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: 5 of the 8 staff files reviewed did not have documented proof of having completed orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: One of the toddler rooms did not have a written activity plan as required
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location: The emergency evacuation diagrams posted in the center do not show the designated location outside of the child-care center where all caregivers and children meet to ensure everyone has exited the child - care center safely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were 3 infants present who were not on table food and did not have written feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The operation did not have a complete first aid kit on the premises as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher in the kitchen does not have a documented inspection since 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: No documentation of monthly smoke detector tests were available to view during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Electrical outlets in classrooms with children younger than 5 were observed to not have child proof covers on them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: There were items in the first aid kit inside the centers van that were expired
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 8 children files were reviewed and 1 did not have the required immunization records or an exemption
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: There was not a current list of children being transported ready to review during the inspection. This was corrected during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Toys used by children while playing outside were observed to have rough sharp edges. Staff were requested to remove the itmes during the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: The 2 exits outside of the play area were locked with both locks and chains and neither of the staff members had the key to unlock them in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: A play structure that requires loose fill did not have the required amount in the use zone. The structure is greater than 5 feet and requires a minimum of 9 inches of loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The center did not have a carbon monoxide detector as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Low hanging powerlines were observed in the area where children play and where one of the emergency exits are located.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: No monthly carbon monoxide testing could be verified during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: 5 of the 8 staff files reviewed did not have documented proof of having completed pre-service training or how they did not require it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: A caregiver used to transport children did not have the required transportation training available to review when requested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: A school aged child was observed watching a television program that was not related to a planned activity that meets educational goals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: No documented monthly inspection of active play equipment or space was available to view. Broken toys, debris, and toys with missing parts were present during inspection and asked to be removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: There were no infant daily reports accessible for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: The infants did not have feeding instructions available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
